_about: 1-Propanol (1) + ETBE (2): isobaric bubble temperatures at 94.0 kPa (no vapour compositions are fitted). Rows: liquid mole fraction of 1-propanol, boiling temperature in K, as stored in the ThermoML Archive record (mole fractions of the other component converted with x_1 = 1 - x_2).

source.citation: Mejia, A.[Andres], Segura, H.[Hugo], Cartes, M.[Marcela], Bustos, P.[Pia], Vapor liquid equilibrium, densities, and interfacial tensions for the system ethyl 1,1-dimethylethyl ether (ETBE) + propan-1-ol, Fluid Phase Equilib. 255 (2007) 121-130
source.access: The journal article may be subscription-only; the same data is public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (NIST open license).
source.tables: ThermoML record, PureOrMixtureData 11. The table number in the article was not checked.

notes: Read with validation/python/vle_batch.py. Fitted to the bubble temperatures alone (Barker's method): no set of this pair with vapour compositions passes the consistency point test, or none was measured. Pure-component boiling points of the set within 0.17 K of the vapour-pressure records. To be checked by a person against the record (AGENTS.md rule 4).
